description: Shared Crossplane types, pure utils (health model, refs, classifier, drawer refs, summarisers, graph layout, query utils), the zod IPC schemas file, and the useResourceSorting numeric-branch refactor, with full unit tests. Implements plan.md items 1-6; design B.6, B.7 (layout), B.8 (schemas), B.10, B.14 and amendments AM-1, AM-2, AM-6. No dependency on other FEATs; FEAT-002..004 depend on it.
steps: Read design.md sections B.6, B.7, B.8, B.10, B.14 and 'Amendments from review v3' (AM-1..AM-6, binding) and plan.md items 1-6.

Create src/types/crossplane.ts: CROSSPLANE_CATEGORIES exactly as AM-1 (16 values incl. packageRevision, compositionRevision), all B.10 types with RevisionRow replacing PackageRevisionSummary (PackageRow.revisions: RevisionRow[]), NeedsAttentionRow = CrossplaneRowBase, DrawerLink, all payload types listed in B.10, and exported constants DNS_SUBDOMAIN, DNS_LABEL, API_VERSION, KIND, KIND_KEY (regexes from B.8).

Create electron/crossplane-ipc-schemas.ts (imports only zod and ../src/types/crossplane): contextSchema, refSchema (.strict(), z.enum(CROSSPLANE_CATEGORIES)), contextOnlySchema, managedItemsSchema, warningEventsSchema, refRequestSchema exactly as B.8, using the regex constants from src/types/crossplane.ts.

Create src/utils/crossplane-utils.ts with the crossview attribution header from B.1: guards, getConditions, deriveHealth (B.6 rules 1-7; packageRevision = revision rule with Inactive -> none; compositionRevision = generic rule), getResourceRefs (spec.crossplane.resourceRefs ?? spec.resourceRefs), getCompositionRef, getClaimRef, getControllerOwner, parseCrdName, pickReferenceableVersion, pickKindVersion, resolveKindVersion, resolveXrdScope, partitionObjectRefs, revisionFingerprint, crossplaneKey, toCrossplaneRef, isValidCrossplaneRef, classifyCrossplaneObject (AM-1: pkg *Revision -> packageRevision, CompositionRevision -> compositionRevision, other core-group unknown kinds -> null, 'managed' only for non-core groups), countHealth, collectNeedsAttention (returns NeedsAttentionRow[], sorted healthOrder asc then healthSince desc, missing last), filterCrossplaneEvents.

Create src/utils/crossplane-drawer-refs.ts (attribution header) with resolveDrawerRefs(category | null, object, ctx: { detection, packages?, definitions? }): DrawerLink[] implementing the AM-2 table row by row; Secret (core v1) refs and refs failing isValidCrossplaneRef(toCrossplaneRef(x)) are emitted without `ref` (text only); null category -> [].

Create src/utils/crossplane-summaries.ts (attribution header): summarizePackage, summarizeRevision (category packageRevision, RevisionRow), summarizeXrd, summarizeComposition, summarizeCompositionRevision (deriveHealth('compositionRevision')), summarizeComposite, summarizeClaim, summarizeManaged, summarizeUsage, summarizeProviderConfig, summarizeRuntimeConfig, summarizeActivationPolicy, summarizeEnvironmentConfig, summarizeOperation. Return null on malformed (missing metadata.name/uid). All count fields numbers defaulting to 0.
Create src/utils/crossplane-query-utils.ts (resolveIntervalMs, shouldFetchOnVisible) and src/utils/crossplane-graph.ts (buildCrossplaneFlow per B.7 renderer layout).

Refactor src/hooks/useResourceSorting.ts (confirm `git status` shows it unmodified first): extract exported pure sortResourceData(data, sortConfig); keep special keys age, restarts, cpu, memory, replicas, status in current order and logic; add `typeof a[key]==='number' && typeof b[key]==='number'` branch just before the default string comparison; hook still returns `getSortedData` and every other current member unchanged.

Create fixtures src/utils/__fixtures__/crossplane-fixtures.ts: Claim; v1 LegacyCluster XR with spec.resourceRefs + spec.claimRef; v2 namespaced XR with spec.crossplane.resourceRefs + claim labels; MRs (Synced/Ready True; Ready=False Creating fresh and 16 min old; Synced=False ReconcileError; LastAsyncOperation=False; paused annotation; deletionTimestamp); ProviderRevision v2 (RevisionHealthy+RuntimeHealthy), v1 (Healthy only), Inactive; Provider/Function/Configuration; XRDs with/without claimNames and spec.scope; Composition with pipeline; CompositionRevision; Usage with resourceRef and with resourceSelector; Operation/CronOperation/WatchOperation; ProviderConfig with credentials.secretRef; an MRD.

Write tests: src/utils/crossplane-utils.test.ts (full B.14 crossplane-utils list + AM-1: deriveHealth('packageRevision') v2/v1/Inactive, classify ProviderRevision -> packageRevision, CompositionRevision -> compositionRevision, MRD -> null, non-core group -> managed, unhealthy revision NeedsAttention row -> toCrossplaneRef -> refRequestSchema parses; raw PackageRow+type fails refRequestSchema; namespace '' omitted); src/utils/crossplane-drawer-refs.test.ts (every AM-2 row; Secret -> text; unresolvable kindVersion -> text; providerConfigRef found/not found incl. namespaced MR; Usage resourceSelector -> 'selector: k=v'; compositeTypeRef with/without XRD; every emitted ref parses refRequestSchema); src/utils/crossplane-summaries.test.ts; src/utils/crossplane-graph.test.ts; src/utils/crossplane-query-utils.test.ts; src/hooks/useResourceSorting.test.ts (9 before 10 asc/desc, healthOrder order, number/undefined -> string path, age/cpu/memory unchanged).
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run` passes all tests: the 311 baseline tests plus every new test file listed in the steps.

`npx eslint --max-warnings 0 src/types/crossplane.ts src/utils/crossplane-utils.ts src/utils/crossplane-drawer-refs.ts src/utils/crossplane-summaries.ts src/utils/crossplane-graph.ts src/utils/crossplane-query-utils.ts src/utils/__fixtures__ src/utils/crossplane-*.test.ts src/hooks/useResourceSorting.ts src/hooks/useResourceSorting.test.ts electron/crossplane-ipc-schemas.ts` reports 0 problems.
CROSSPLANE_CATEGORIES equals the AM-1 list; classifyCrossplaneObject returns null for an MRD and never 'managed' for a core Crossplane group (asserted by tests).
Every new file is < 500 lines (`wc -l`). No new file uses `any`.
useResourceSorting still exports the hook returning getSortedData; GenericResourceView compiles unchanged.
